# Fixture: broken_tu

Three translation units for the analysis driver (B-07):

- `ok.c` uses the project header `include/util.h` and standard headers
  (`<stddef.h>` comes from Clang's resource directory, `<stdio.h>` from the
  system), so it parses only if both are found.
- `broken.c` has a syntax error on line 4.
- `also_ok.c` sorts before `broken.c`; together with `ok.c` it shows that
  analysis continues after a failed translation unit.

`include/forced.h` has no `#include` and is only ever added with
`-include`, so no directive reaches it (B-08).

The compilation database is generated by the test with absolute paths.
